summary: Serban 2016 (27405810; 7 RCTs, 9 arms, 587 adults, quercetin 100-1000 mg/day for 4-10 weeks) found small reductions in SBP (-3.04 mmHg) and DBP (-2.63 mmHg), which were lost when one trial was removed; the 2022 meta-analysis abstract (35948195, 10 RCTs) points the same way. This is credited only for blood-pressure support, the scope of Dr. Pham's decision, and immune/antiviral claims are excluded.

applicability.studied_population: Adults, mostly normotensive (one prehypertension/stage 1 trial), taking 100-1000 mg/day oral quercetin for 4-10 weeks.

identity.chemical_form: Quercetin (oral, trial-specific preparations; aglycone/formulation not uniformly reported)

population.description: 7 placebo-controlled RCTs (9 arms), 587 adults (299 quercetin, 288 control): women with or without type 2 diabetes, healthy adults, prehypertension/stage 1 hypertension (1 trial), metabolic syndrome traits, male smokers and APOE-genotyped men; all but one trial in people without hypertension.

study_contexts.study_design: Systematic review and meta-analysis of placebo-controlled RCTs (5 parallel, 2 crossover) of oral quercetin; BP (SBP, DBP) was the review outcome; fixed or random effects by I2.

outcomes.name: Systolic BP WMD -3.04 mmHg (95% CI -5.75 to -0.33), P=0.028; nonsignificant (-1.78, -4.07 to 0.52) after removing Zahedi et al
Diastolic BP WMD -2.63 mmHg (95% CI -3.26 to -2.01), P<0.001; nonsignificant (-0.98, -2.44 to 0.49) after removing Zahedi et al
Dose subgroups: >=500 mg/day significant, <500 mg/day not, but indirect comparison showed no significant between-dose difference

limitations: Pooled BP effects depend on a single trial (Zahedi et al); sensitivity analysis removing it made both SBP and DBP nonsignificant (Results).
Mostly normotensive populations; BP was a prespecified primary endpoint in only some trials (Table 1). Not hypertension treatment or cardiovascular-event evidence.
Do not turn the >=500 mg/day subgroup into a proven threshold; indirect between-dose comparison was not significant.
Returned decision A105: immune/antiviral transfer rejected; scope is blood-pressure support only.
35948195 (2022, 10 RCTs, 841 participants) abstract reports SBP -2.38 mmHg and consistent direction; full text not accessible, so it is not a context source.

dose.administration_frequency: Daily oral dosing per trial; within-day schedule not reported in Table 1.
dosage_forms: not reported by source: oral quercetin supplements (Table 1 route 'Oral')
co_therapies: Some trials required unchanged background medications (Table 1 inclusion criteria); no assigned co-therapy.
dose.reported_regimen: Table 1: 500, 500, 1000, 730, 150, 100 and 150 mg/day; durations 4-10 weeks (Results: doses 100-1000 mg/day, 4-10 weeks).
